name: High-vol-window trend ride — the seasonality mirror (1h)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (the MIRROR of the calm-window drift: instead of drifting long in calm windows, ride MOMENTUM only in the high-vol session windows and stay flat in the calm — testing the other tail of the intraday seasonality so the family spans both regimes and the sign is falsifiable): crypto realized vol is partly deterministic by clock (session overlaps + funding-settlement). The calm-window thesis says reversion is cleanest when calm; the mirror says the high-vol windows are where genuine trends actually travel, and calm-window trend signals are noise. Entry (long): vol_realized above a fitted floor (a high-vol session window is active) AND ret_Nd positive (a real up-move underway) AND adx above a fitted floor (trend confirmed, not chop). We ride the move while the window is energetic and exit as it calms. Realized features only (no DVOL) -> dodges the data wall. Exit: vol_realized crosses down through a fitted level (the high-vol window is ending -> trend fuel gone) or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: if an unconditional 1h momentum long (drop the vol_realized floor) matches the deflated Sharpe, the high-vol-window conditioning adds nothing and this is plain trend-following. DISCONFIRMER 2: if this AND the calm-window drift (hh-volatility-14) BOTH clear on the same symbols, the intraday-vol conditioning is not selecting a regime — one of them is spurious. DISCONFIRMER 3: high-vol windows cluster around scheduled macro events; if excluding CPI/FOMC dates kills it, it's event-momentum not seasonality.
catalyst: the energetic high-vol session window where genuine intraday trends travel
